events.title: Petrarch climbs Mont Ventoux for the view
events.description: The poet Petrarch climbed Mont Ventoux in Provence, by his own account simply to see the view from the summit. His letter describing it is often cited as an early sign of a new attitude to nature.
events.html: The poet Petrarch climbed Mont Ventoux in Provence, by his own account simply to see the view from the summit. His letter describing it is often cited as an early sign of a new attitude to nature.

events.title: The Pazzi conspirators kill Giuliano de' Medici in Florence Cathedral
events.description: Members of the Pazzi conspiracy, a plot to displace the Medici as rulers of Florence, stabbed Giuliano de' Medici to death in Florence Cathedral and wounded his brother Lorenzo. The Pazzi were afterwards banished from Florence and their property confiscated.

events.title: William Shakespeare is baptised in Stratford-upon-Avon
events.description: The parish register of Holy Trinity Church records the baptism of 'Gulielmus filius Johannes Shakspere'. It is the earliest documentary record of the playwright.
events.html: The parish register of Holy Trinity Church records the baptism of 'Gulielmus filius Johannes Shakspere'. It is the earliest documentary record of the playwright.

events.title: An earthquake devastates the Iranian city of Tabriz
events.description: An earthquake with its epicentre near Tabriz levelled some three-quarters of the city, including many prominent mosques and schools, and killed tens of thousands of people. The destruction was a significant factor in the Ottoman takeover of Tabriz in 1725.

events.title: John Wilkes Booth is cornered and killed in Virginia
events.description: Union troops trapped Lincoln's assassin in a tobacco barn and set it alight; Booth was shot by Sergeant Boston Corbett and died within hours. It ended a twelve-day manhunt.
events.html: Union troops trapped Lincoln's assassin in a tobacco barn and set it alight; Booth was shot by Sergeant Boston Corbett and died within hours. It ended a twelve-day manhunt.

events.title: Italy signs the secret Treaty of London with the Entente
events.description: Italy concluded a secret agreement with the United Kingdom, France and Russia, promising to enter the First World War on the Entente side within a month in return for Trentino, South Tyrol, Trieste, Istria, part of Dalmatia and other gains.

events.title: German and Italian aircraft bomb Guernica
events.description: The Condor Legion, with Italian support, bombed the Basque town on market day, killing hundreds of civilians. The attack inspired Picasso's painting Guernica.
events.html: The Condor Legion, with Italian support, bombed the Basque town on market day, killing hundreds of civilians. The attack inspired Picasso's painting Guernica.

events.title: Reactor explodes at the Chernobyl nuclear plant
events.description: A safety test went wrong at reactor No. 4 in Soviet Ukraine, causing an explosion and fire that spread radioactive fallout across Europe. Over 100,000 people were evacuated.
